_comment: Per-invariant violation FLOORS for the reference sweep (ReferenceConfig: seeds 1..60 x 2000 steps x MaxWindows 12, DefaultConfig otherwise). cmd/fuzz-gate fails CI if any invariant EXCEEDS its floor, or if a brand-new invariant class (not listed here) appears. Floors are the CURRENT measured value so the gate is green now; each non-zero floor carries a justification so a reviewer can drive it down. Triage categories: (clean)=zero, genuine residual=0; (sim)=sim-model limitation artifact; (gen)=aggressive-generator artifact; (prod)=open production bug awaiting a fix. Update procedure: run `go run ./cmd/fuzz-gate -update` to regenerate, then justify any change in review.

justifications.no-crash: (clean) HandleEvent never panics. Floor 0 — any panic is a real bug.
justifications.no-invalid-cmd: (clean) sim never records an unsupported command. Floor 0.
justifications.no-sway-reject: (clean) sim never records a command real sway would refuse. Floor 0.
justifications.focus-convergence: (clean) at most one focused leaf after any step. Floor 0.
justifications.no-handler-error: (clean) no layout manager returns an Error-level failure. Floor 0.
justifications.maximized-fold-intact: (clean) REAL-bug class. A manager claiming maximized MUST actually be folded (master sharing the stack column, parent tabbed) — the shape toggleMaximize builds and the unmax branch assumes. Floor 0. This exists because `maximized` is an assertion-SUPPRESSION switch the manager owns: master-width-honored and master-stack-split both SKIP a maximized workspace, so a stale-true flag silently disables them — the bug and its own detector in one. That is how the 2026-07-16 state-drift bug (popWindow leaving the flag set after the fold collapsed) hid for hundreds of steps until an unmaximize replayed its restore against a never-folded tree.
justifications.master-width-honored: (clean) REAL-bug class after the deliverable-1 split: master width is only checked when the layout structure is HEALTHY (master does NOT share its parent with a stack window). Floor 0 — a master-width regression (e.g. reverting 6ae4d4a's stale-rect snapshot) drives this NON-ZERO (measured: 8 over this reference config). This is the gate's primary master-width signal. Held at 0 through the 2026-08-12 moveDir fidelity change, including on a 200-seed x 5000-step sweep (3.3x the reference).
justifications.master-width-degenerate: (clean as of 2026-08-12, was 120) FALSE-POSITIVE class split off from master-width-honored: the master shares its parent with stack windows, i.e. the stack column is already missing (the master-stack-split bug shape), so `resize 75 ppt` is divided across degenerate siblings and the width is meaningless BY CONSTRUCTION. Driving master-stack-split down drives this down, which is exactly what happened: 120 -> 0 when moveDir started modeling sway's real promote-at-edge behavior, because MasterStack's `move <opposite-of-stack-side>` master extraction (popWindow, unmaximize) now actually extracts instead of silently no-opping. Floor 0 — treat any reappearance as a structural regression in master/stack separation.
justifications.no-wrapper-chain: (sim+gen+prod) Persistent singleton-wrapper chains; cumulative-with-persistence, so one bad state recounts every step (906 counts = 246 distinct runs). Raised 394 -> 906 on 2026-08-12 by the moveDir fidelity change: directional moves used to be intra-parent swaps that no-opped at an edge, so a raw `move left`/`move right` could never strand a wrapper. Now they promote, as sway does. The first reproducer (seed=1 step=203) is NOT a layout-manager bug but the hub's nativeSwayFallback: `nop tilekeeper move left workspace 7` on an UNMANAGED workspace forwards a scopeless `move left`, which sway applies to whatever is focused — a window on a DIFFERENT, managed workspace, restructuring it behind that manager's back. Guarding the fallback on 'the named workspace actually holds focus' measured 906 -> 624; deliberately left for the follow-up in docs/handoff-tabbed-workspace-criteria.md rather than widening the ws8 fix. Remainder is the pre-existing MasterStack-flatten-foreign-trees gap.
justifications.tabbed-strip-flat: (prod) NEW class, added 2026-08-12 with the ws8 tab-escape fix: every tiled window on a Tabbed-managed workspace must be a tab in ONE flat strip. The escape the invariant was written for (a `move` at the strip edge tearing a window out, leaving it tiled at half width beside the tabs) is FIXED and contributes 0 — this floor is a different, pre-existing bug: switching a chaotic MasterStack workspace to tabbed (`nop tilekeeper layout tabbed` on a deeply nested 60-leaf tree) leaves the windows nested, because flattenToTabs needs a workspace-direct leaf to anchor its `move to mark` lift and bails when every leaf is nested and FlattenSingletons makes no progress. 481 counts = 136 distinct runs. Drive to 0 by giving flattenToTabs an anchor-of-last-resort; see docs/handoff-tabbed-workspace-criteria.md.
justifications.tracked-matches-leaves: (sim+gen) Manager tracking vs sim leaf set. Dominated by genContainerWorkspaceMove moving whole workspaces repeatedly and stranding fellow-traveler leaves. Cumulative-with-persistence (47231 counts = 9280 distinct runs); largest residual. Raised 38331 -> 47231 on 2026-08-12 by the moveDir fidelity change — every seed's trajectory re-rolls once directional moves actually restructure the tree, and the chaotic foreign trees the generator builds now drift further from what a manager tracks. The old justification blamed part of this residual on 'sim moveDir cannot cross container boundaries'; that limitation is gone, so what remains is generator-driven.
justifications.master-stack-split: (sim+gen+prod) Master shares its parent with a stack window (stack column missing). LOWERED 12967 -> 3785 on 2026-08-12 by the moveDir fidelity change: MasterStack extracts a promoted master with a bare `move <opposite-of-stack-side>` (popWindow, unmaximize), which the old intra-parent sim model turned into a no-op, so the master stayed buried in the stack column for the rest of the walk. Modeling sway's real promotion makes those extractions work, and the residual drops by 71% (105238 -> 43184 on the 200-seed x 5000-step sweep). Remainder is the aggressive workspace-move generator plus the MasterStack-not-flattening-foreign-trees follow-up. Residual ratchets re-baseline on a deliberate behavior change; floor-0 classes never do.
